PRIVACY

Your information.
A straightforward approach.

How information is handled on the EasyOra website.

Last updated: 15 October 2026

Project brief builder

The brief builder processes your entries in your browser to create text you can copy. It does not submit a form, send an email, or save your entries to a database or browser storage. The copy button uses your browser’s clipboard permission to copy the generated text. Your clipboard may retain it until you replace it.

Cookies and analytics

This website does not add analytics scripts, advertising trackers, or application cookies. Fonts and visual assets are served with the site. Your animation preference applies to the current page and is not saved. Reduced-motion and data-saving preferences are respected where supported by your browser.

Website hosting

This website is hosted on Vercel. The hosting platform may process technical request information, such as IP addresses and request logs, to deliver and operate the site. Hosting practices are governed by the platform’s own policies.

Information you choose to share

Copying a brief does not send it to EasyOra. If you share it using another service, that service’s handling of your information applies. Avoid including confidential credentials or sensitive personal information.

Contact details

EasyOra’s public email and WhatsApp destinations have not yet been supplied for this website. This notice will be updated if contact submission, analytics, or other data processing is added.
